{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for LOYAL customers
loyal_customers = sales_df[sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute conversion fraction
n_loyal = len(loyal_customers)
n_converted_loyal = loyal_customers['converted'].sum()
conversion_fraction = n_converted_loyal / n_loyal

# Print each required number explicitly
print("n_loyal:", n_loyal)
print("n_converted_loyal:", n_converted_loyal)
print("conversion_fraction:", conversion_fraction)"}
